rules.rookie: First NFL season is 2013: years_exp 0 in the earliest 2013 regular-season roster_weekly row, or a branch rookie contract on the register.
rules.comeback: Not a rookie, years_exp >= 2 in 2013, at least 8 2011 regular-season games and at most 6 2012 regular-season games with a recorded statistic (nflverse player_stats and player_stats_def, REG): an established player who lost most of 2012.
rules.line_start: The five available game-day active offensive linemen with the lowest depth in the frozen TeamInput start that game.
rules.head_coach: Opening-day head coach; the branch records no in-season change.
